tests.requirement: No default storefront response on any cart/order route (create, line items add/update/delete, update, promotions, shipping, payment collection/session, complete, order) carries the global customer id or relation
tests.evidence: Opus re-review probe first FAILED on DELETE /store/carts/:id/line-items/:line_id (parent cart carried the global customer; route had no response backstop). Fixed by stripping customer/customer_id at any depth on every guarded storefront response

tests.requirement: Field-expansion variants (nested address paths, wildcards, array/object/repeated params, whitespace) cannot reach the global customer id
tests.evidence: RT04: 15 variants, statuses logged; no response contains the global cus_ id. Field rejection is now segment-based at any depth

tests.requirement: An environment-bound automatic promotion applies only in its own store; the other store receives no discount and checks out normally
tests.evidence: Independent final review MI-1: Petya automatic promotion was applied to Maria carts and blocked Maria checkout (400 tenant isolation violation). Fixed by store_environment_id promotion rule plus server-derived cart promotion context

tests.requirement: Unbound automatic promotions are rejected at creation; promotions created below workflows are bound on provisioning, never cross stores, and cannot be claimed by another store
tests.evidence: Reproduces the reviewer's probe P1 shape (rule-less automatic promotion created via the promotion module, assigned to Petya): Maria cart unaffected and completes; Petya cart gets it; Maria claim rejected
